disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有源码和配置文件中涉及凭据密钥读取的路径（如 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa、.aws/credentials 等模式），以及读取这些路径的代码路径。未发现任何凭据文件读取操作。插件只读取 Steam 安装目录下的配置文件和壁纸项目文件，不访问任何凭据相关路径。
checked_items.en: Checked all paths in the source code and configuration files that involve reading credentials or secrets (such as .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, .aws/credentials, etc.), as well as the code paths that read these paths. No credential file read operations were found. The plugin only reads configuration files under the Steam installation directory and wallpaper project files, and does not access any credential-related paths.

evidence.zh: 检查了全部源码中是否读取 $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml、~/.ssh 等敏感路径，并检查了外联代码路径。未发现任何凭据文件读取操作。插件的网络外发仅用于下载 ffmpeg 二进制文件（sha256 固定版本），无凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: Checked whether the entire source code reads sensitive paths such as $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, etc., and examined the outbound network code paths. No credential file read operations were found. The plugin's only outbound network traffic is for downloading the ffmpeg binary (fixed sha256 version), with no credential exfiltration channel.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全量源码中是否存在 ctx.tools.register 工具描述、ctx.systemPrompt.section 系统提示注入、SKILL.md/AGENTS.md 指令文件，以及 README 文档中的注入措辞。插件未注册任何模型可见工具，未注入任何系统提示，不存在指令文件。README 为纯用户文档，不含注入措辞。同时检查了上下文历史压缩引擎（CompactionEngine 子类）与附件存储实现（AttachmentStore 子类），均未实现。
checked_items.en: Checked the full source for ctx.tools.register tool descriptions, ctx.systemPrompt.section system prompt injections, SKILL.md/AGENTS.md instruction files, and injection wording in README documentation. The plugin registers no model-visible tools, injects no system prompts, and contains no instruction files. The README is pure user documentation with no injection wording. Also checked the context history compression engine (CompactionEngine subclass) and attachment storage implementation (AttachmentStore subclass); neither is implemented.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用 ctx.tools.register 或 ctx.systemPrompt.section，不注册任何模型可见工具或系统提示片段。没有可供投毒的工具描述或提示词面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call ctx.tools.register or ctx.systemPrompt.section, and registers no model-visible tools or system prompt snippets. There is no tool description or prompt surface available for poisoning.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何模型可见工具，不存在工具描述可诱导安装或改写配置。README 中提供的安装命令是标准的 dsh plugin add 用法，属于正常使用说明。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no model-visible tools, so no tool description could induce installation or config rewriting. The install command in the README is standard dsh plugin add usage and constitutes normal usage instructions.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听 agent/pre-step 事件，不存在改写或注入模型输入消息的机制。上下文压缩引擎与附件存储实现同样未提供，历史篡改面无代码锚点。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to the agent/pre-step event, so there is no mechanism to rewrite or inject model input messages. The context compression engine and attachment storage implementation are likewise not provided, leaving no code anchor for history tampering.

checked_items.zh:
机器预扫命中的 13 条记录已逐条裁决（均为良性排除，不构成 finding）：

1. DSH-X07（映射 DG-R3-59）@ .github/workflows/auto-merge-mac.yml——GitHub Actions 自动合并工作流，仅作用于 dsh-wallpaper-engine-mac 开发分支，在 GitHub 端运行、不接触用户机器，不下载执行远程内容，属开发流程工程惯例，排除。

2. DSH-X05（映射 DG-R3-57）@ lib/client.js:1874、src/client.js:1898——window 级键盘监听，仅在设置弹窗打开时捕获 Escape 关闭弹窗；@ lib/client.js:3016、src/client.js:3040（对应 document 级键盘监听）用于关闭下拉仓库面板，均为正常 UI 交互，无键盘记录或剪贴板行为，排除。

3. DSH-X08（映射 DG-R3-60）@ lib/client.js:2860、src/client.js:2884——超长行与高熵 blob 为同一常量 ROPE_IMG：经 splice_rope.cjs 确认是装饰性拉绳图片的 PNG base64 数据 URI（151KB 图片数据，熵值 6.0 为 base64 二进制典型值），非混淆代码，排除。

4. DSH-X03（映射 DG-R3-55）@ lib/index.js:56——import { execFile, spawn } 用于调用 reg.exe 查询 Steam 注册表（固定参数、5 秒超时）和 spawn ffmpeg 做视频帧率上限转码（固定参数列表、无 shell 字符串拼接，作业有超时与进程清理），属插件声明业务，排除。

5. DSH-X01（映射 DG-R3-53）@ lib/types/client.d.ts:7——仅类型声明文件中的文档注释提及 cordis_define，全量源码无任何 cordis_define/cordis_run 调用，排除。

6. DSH-X02（映射 DG-R3-54）@ package.json:64（prepare 钩子）与 scripts/prepare.mjs:14（spawnSync）——prepare 脚本在源码检出时运行 build-client.mjs 打包浏览器端代码，spawnSync 只调用自身 Node.js 进程执行本地构建脚本；发布 tarball 不含 src/ 目录时 prepare 为无操作；不下载不执行远程内容，排除。
checked_items.en:
The 13 records hit by the machine pre-scan have been adjudicated one by one (all benign exclusions, not findings):

1. DSH-X07 (mapped to DG-R3-59) @ .github/workflows/auto-merge-mac.yml — GitHub Actions auto-merge workflow, only acts on the dsh-wallpaper-engine-mac development branch, runs on the GitHub side, does not touch the user's machine, does not download and execute remote content, and is a common development workflow engineering practice. Excluded.

2. DSH-X05 (mapped to DG-R3-57) @ lib/client.js:1874, src/client.js:1898 — window-level keyboard listener, only captures Escape to close the settings modal when it is open; @ lib/client.js:3016, src/client.js:3040 (corresponding document-level keyboard listener) is used to close the dropdown repository panel. Both are normal UI interactions, with no keylogging or clipboard behavior. Excluded.

3. DSH-X08 (mapped to DG-R3-60) @ lib/client.js:2860, src/client.js:2884 — the over-long line and high-entropy blob are the same constant ROPE_IMG: confirmed via splice_rope.cjs to be a PNG base64 data URI of a decorative rope image (151KB image data, with entropy 6.0 typical of base64 binary), not obfuscated code. Excluded.

4. DSH-X03 (mapped to DG-R3-55) @ lib/index.js:56 — import { execFile, spawn } is used to call reg.exe to query the Steam registry (fixed parameters, 5-second timeout) and to spawn ffmpeg for video frame-rate-limited transcoding (fixed parameter list, no shell string concatenation, jobs have timeouts and process cleanup). This falls within the plugin's declared business scope. Excluded.

5. DSH-X01 (mapped to DG-R3-53) @ lib/types/client.d.ts:7 — only a documentation comment in a type declaration file mentions cordis_define; the full source contains no cordis_define/cordis_run calls. Excluded.

6. DSH-X02 (mapped to DG-R3-54) @ package.json:64 (prepare hook) and scripts/prepare.mjs:14 (spawnSync) — the prepare script runs build-client.mjs to package the browser-side code when the source is checked out; spawnSync only calls its own Node.js process to execute the local build script; when the published tarball does not contain the src/ directory, prepare is a no-op; it does not download or execute remote content. Excluded.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅包含一个 insert 行注册插件自身，不含 !!js 或 !!js/function 等可执行 YAML 标量。patch 文件无 eval 风险。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains only a single insert line registering the plugin itself, with no executable YAML scalars such as !!js or !!js/function. The patch file has no eval risk.

evidence.zh: 全量源码中未发现任何 cordis_define 或 cordis_run 调用。lib/types/client.d.ts 的注释中提及 cordis_define 但仅为文档说明，非实际调用。
evidence.en: No cordis_define or cordis_run calls were found in the full source. The comment in lib/types/client.d.ts mentions cordis_define but only as documentation, not as an actual call.

evidence.zh: prepare 脚本（scripts/prepare.mjs）在源码检出时运行 build-client.mjs 构建浏览器端 bundle，使用 spawnSync(node, ...) 调用自身 Node.js 进程编译源码，不下载或执行远程内容。发布的 tarball 中 src/ 目录不在 files 清单内，prepare 为无操作。Git 安装不锁定 commit 是宿主 CLI 的默认行为，插件自身无责任。
evidence.en: The prepare script (scripts/prepare.mjs) runs build-client.mjs to build the browser-side bundle at source checkout, using spawnSync(node, ...) to call its own Node.js process to compile the source, and does not download or execute remote content. The src/ directory is not in the files list of the published tarball, so prepare is a no-op. Git installs not locking commits is default host CLI behavior; the plugin itself bears no responsibility.

evidence.zh: manifest 声明了 dsh.client（client-bundle）——客户端 bundle 被自动加载。经检查客户端代码：仅使用 React 渲染 UI、通过同源 HTTP 请求获取壁纸列表和媒体资源；键盘事件仅用于 UI 交互（Escape 关闭弹窗），无键盘记录、无剪贴板访问、无 credentials.set 调用、无外部域名请求。
evidence.en: The manifest declares dsh.client (client-bundle) — the client bundle is auto-loaded. Inspection of the client code shows: it only uses React to render the UI, fetches wallpaper lists and media assets via same-origin HTTP requests; keyboard events are used only for UI interaction (Escape closes modals), with no keylogging, no clipboard access, no credentials.set calls, and no requests to external domains.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用 ctx.subagents.registerProvider，不注册任何子代理提供方。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call ctx.subagents.registerProvider and registers no subagent provider.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用 ctx.jobs.start、schedule_create、create_goal/update_goal，不注册任何后台任务、定时提醒或持久目标；未监听 agent/turn-stopping 事件。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call ctx.jobs.start, schedule_create, or create_goal/update_goal, and registers no background tasks, scheduled reminders, or persistent goals; it does not listen to the agent/turn-stopping event.

checked_items.zh:
检查了所有外联域名、网络请求、curl/wget 命令调用、隧道/编码外发模式。插件的网络外发仅限于：

1. 运行时按需下载 ffmpeg 二进制文件（从 registry.npmmirror.com 和 github.com/eugeneware/ffmpeg-static，sha256 固定版本校验 + 魔数验证）。

2. 浏览器端客户端仅通过同源 HTTP 请求（/wallpaper-engine/*）与宿主通信，不访问任何外部域名。

未发现凭据外泄、编码外发、DNS 隧道、数据外发通道等模式。
checked_items.en:
Checked all outbound domains, network requests, curl/wget command invocations, and tunneling/encoding exfiltration patterns. The plugin's outbound network traffic is limited to:

1. Downloading the ffmpeg binary on demand at runtime (from registry.npmmirror.com and github.com/eugeneware/ffmpeg-static, with sha256 fixed-version verification plus magic-number validation).

2. The browser-side client communicates with the host only via same-origin HTTP requests (/wallpaper-engine/*), without accessing any external domain.

No patterns such as credential exfiltration, encoded exfiltration, DNS tunneling, or data exfiltration channels were found.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件，未调用 ctx.llm.registerAdapter，没有劫持 LLM 路由或接管错误恢复的机制。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to agent/request or agent/request-error events, does not call ctx.llm.registerAdapter, and has no mechanism to hijack LLM routing or take over error recovery.

checked_items.zh:
检查了 install 钩子、依赖声明、patch 配置安全行覆盖、waterfall 事件监听截断、版本升级自动激活、作者身份等维度。

1. DSH-X02（映射 DG-R3-54）prepare 脚本经分析确认良性：仅构建期编译客户端源码，不下载远程包。

2. cordis.patch.yml 仅包含插件自身的 insert 行，未修改 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全配置，未使用环境变量降权，未修改 inject/intercept 配置。

3. 插件未监听 tools/pre-execute 或 approval/request 事件，不存在审批链截断风险。

4. 首次审计，无版本基线，版本升级自动激活场景不适用。

5. 作者账号通过 GitHub 公开注册，无其他身份风险信号。

6. 插件 manifest 未显式声明能力字段（network/shell/fs/modelFacing），declared_capabilities 按代码实测推断为 network:true, shell:true, fs:full, modelFacing:false，与插件实际行为一致（壁纸服务需要本地文件读取、ffmpeg 转码需要子进程和网络下载）。该声明缺口已在 audit_scope.limits 中注明。
checked_items.en:
Checked dimensions including the install hook, dependency declarations, patch config security-line coverage, waterfall event listener truncation, automatic activation on version upgrades, and author identity.

1. DSH-X02 (mapped to DG-R3-54) prepare script was analyzed and confirmed benign: it only compiles client source code during build and does not download remote packages.

2. cordis.patch.yml contains only the plugin's own insert line, does not modify security configurations such as sandbox/approval/permission, does not use environment variables to downgrade privileges, and does not modify inject/intercept configurations.

3. The plugin does not listen to tools/pre-execute or approval/request events, so there is no risk of approval-chain truncation.

4. First audit, no version baseline, so the version-upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

5. The author account is publicly registered via GitHub, with no other identity risk signals.

6. The plugin manifest does not explicitly declare capability fields (network/shell/fs/modelFacing); declared_capabilities was inferred from the code as network:true, shell:true, fs:full, modelFacing:false, consistent with the plugin's actual behavior (wallpaper service needs local file reads, ffmpeg transcoding needs subprocesses and network downloads). This declaration gap has been noted in audit_scope.limits.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅包含一个 insert 行，不触碰 sandbox/approval/permission/loader 等安全行，未使用 disabled:true 或环境变量降权，不修改 inject/intercept 配置。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains only a single insert line, does not touch security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission/loader, does not use disabled:true or environment variables to downgrade privileges, and does not modify inject/intercept configurations.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听 tools/pre-execute 或 approval/request 事件，不存在 prepend 截断审批链的机制。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to tools/pre-execute or approval/request events, so there is no mechanism to prepend and truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较版本升级的能力声明变化。
evidence.en: First audit, no version baseline to compare capability declaration changes across version upgrades.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅包含 insert 行，不修改 inject 或 intercept 配置，不会给其他插件追加不存在的必需服务。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains only an insert line, does not modify inject or intercept configurations, and will not append nonexistent required services for other plugins.

checked_items.zh:
检查了插件是否启动 web 服务或监听端口，以及动态行为面。

1. 插件未自行启动网络服务或监听端口，而是通过 ctx.webServer 向宿主 webserver 注册 HTTP 路由。宿主 webserver 无认证层属生态固有风险（DG-S10），非本插件新增面。

2. 插件注册的 HTTP 路由包括：壁纸清单、媒体流、预览图、场景帧提取、场景 WebGL 播放器、自定义上传、设置读写等。这些路由仅通过 loopback 可访问，属于插件声明业务范围。

3. 未提供动态沙箱验证（DG-L4）。
checked_items.en:
Checked whether the plugin starts a web service or listens on ports, as well as the dynamic behavior surface.

1. The plugin does not start its own network service or listen on ports; instead, it registers HTTP routes with the host webserver via ctx.webServer. The host webserver's lack of an authentication layer is an inherent ecosystem risk (DG-S10), not a new surface introduced by this plugin.

2. The HTTP routes registered by the plugin include: wallpaper list, media streaming, preview images, scene frame extraction, scene WebGL player, custom upload, settings read/write, and more. These routes are accessible only via loopback and fall within the plugin's declared business scope.

3. No dynamic sandbox verification was provided (DG-L4).

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动 web 服务或监听端口，而是通过 ctx.webServer 向宿主 webserver 注册路由。宿主 webserver 的无认证 RPC 面属生态固有风险（DG-S10），非本插件新增。插件注册的 /wallpaper-engine/* 路由（含上传/删除/设置读写/转码触发）在 loopback 上无认证暴露，属宿主设计局限。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own web service or listen on ports; instead, it registers routes with the host webserver via ctx.webServer. The host webserver's unauthenticated RPC surface is an inherent ecosystem risk (DG-S10), not introduced by this plugin. The /wallpaper-engine/* routes registered by the plugin (including upload/delete/settings read-write/transcode trigger) are exposed without authentication on loopback, which is a host design limitation.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份校验通过：插件声明完整（dsh.bundle + dsh.client），包名无品牌仿冒风险，依赖版本锁定于 package-lock.json。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the plugin declaration is complete (dsh.bundle + dsh.client), the package name has no brand-impersonation risk, and dependency versions are locked in package-lock.json.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：13 条机器预扫命中（DSH-X02/X03/X05/X07/X08，对应 DG-R3-54/55/57/59/60）经逐条裁决确认均为良性行为——prepare 脚本为构建期操作、child_process 用于 Steam 注册表查询和 ffmpeg 转码（固定参数无注入）、键盘监听为 UI 交互（Escape 关闭弹窗）、超长 base64 行为装饰图片数据 URI、CI 工作流为开发分支自动合并。
summary.en: Static scan completed: the 13 machine pre-scan hits (DSH-X02/X03/X05/X07/X08, mapped to DG-R3-54/55/57/59/60) were all adjudicated one by one and confirmed benign — the prepare script is a build-time operation, child_process is used for Steam registry queries and ffmpeg transcoding (fixed parameters, no injection), keyboard listeners are UI interactions (Escape closes modals), the over-long base64 blob is a decorative image data URI, and the CI workflow is auto-merge for a development branch.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：install 钩子（prepare）仅构建客户端源码，不下载远程执行内容；ffmpeg 下载使用 sha256 固定版本；无混淆载荷或编码执行。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: the install hook (prepare) only builds the client source code and does not download remote executable content; the ffmpeg download uses a fixed sha256 version; no obfuscated payload or encoded execution exists.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：插件未注册任何模型可见工具，未注入系统提示，不存在指令文件或工具描述投毒面。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: the plugin registers no model-visible tools, injects no system prompts, and has no instruction files or tool-description poisoning surface.

limits.zh:
1. 动态沙箱（DG-L4）未启用，运行时行为仅基于静态分析判断。
2. 插件 manifest 未显式声明能力字段（network/shell/fs/modelFacing），declared_capabilities 按代码实测推断。
3. 插件最多可向两个已知域名（registry.npmmirror.com、github.com/eugeneware/ffmpeg-static）发起 HTTPS 下载请求，用于获取 ffmpeg 二进制文件（sha256 固定版本）。
4. 插件注册的 HTTP 路由无认证层，但宿主 webserver 的 loopback 无认证属生态固有设计，非本插件独有风险。
5. src/client.js 文件较大（377KB），部分行因超长未全文读取，但关键区域（键盘监听、网络请求、凭据访问）均通过分段读取验证。
limits.en:
1. Dynamic sandboxing (DG-L4) is not enabled; runtime behavior is judged only from static analysis.
2. The plugin manifest does not explicitly declare capability fields (network/shell/fs/modelFacing); declared_capabilities was inferred from the code.
3. The plugin can make HTTPS download requests to at most two known domains (registry.npmmirror.com, github.com/eugeneware/ffmpeg-static) to obtain the ffmpeg binary (fixed sha256 version).
4. The HTTP routes registered by the plugin have no authentication layer, but the host webserver's unauthenticated loopback is inherent ecosystem design, not a risk unique to this plugin.
5. src/client.js is large (377KB), and some lines were not fully read due to excessive length, but key regions (keyboard listeners, network requests, credential access) were verified via segmented reads.
